## Conflicts preserved

- ERR-001: AUTH-RUSTC-WASM64-DOC <-> AUTH-WASM-CORE-CHANGES-64 - rustc prose 'not standardized' vs Core Release 3.0 64-bit address space; bounded by the authority split (CON-RS-003)
- ERR-002: AUTH-WASM-JSAPI-STORAGE <-> AUTH-WASM-THREADS - agent-local JS embedding vs proposal shared memory
- ERR-002: CON-WA-005 <-> CON-THREAD-001
- ERR-003: AUTH-WASM-SET <-> AUTH-WASM-CORE-CHANGES-64 - proposal machinery vs current baseline
- OBS-D11-1: AUTH-CHROMIUM-SWIFTSHADER-DOC <-> AUTH-GPU-FALLBACK-ADAPTER - implementation doc says SwiftShader is a WebGL/GL fallback 'not intended for untrusted content'; the specification defines fallback adapters abstractly; neither says the SwiftShader WebGPU path is a hardware adapter
